intent: In-place breathing idle, seamlessly looping, with subtle full-body sway and an up-and-down pelvis rhythm; no locomotion.
phases: f0–f103: sway from near the loop center toward the -X extreme, ending with the pelvis in a lower position.
f104–f172: cross from -X to +X; the pelvis passes through its highest point at f148, then lowers into the +X extreme.
f173–f244: reverse sway from +X back to -X, ending at the second -X extreme.
f245–f298: return from -X to the loop center and close back into the starting pose.
keyPoses: f0: loop-start neutral, pelvis near center.
f148: highest pelvis point while crossing through center.
weightTransfer: The pelvis shifts weight laterally in the sequence -X → +X → -X → center. The evidence is sufficient to confirm lateral weight shift, but not strong enough to assign a specific supporting leg, so no support foot is annotated.
bodyMechanics: Across the f103→f172 arc, the pelvis/lower body moves low → rises → reaches its highest point → lowers while moving laterally from -X to +X; the torso, head, and both relaxed arms adjust continuously with the sway rhythm. The motion remains in place, with no locomotion steps.

recommended: in-place breathing idle with clear lateral body sway;
relaxed/low-energy humanoid idle requiring full-body secondary motion.
notPrimary: nearly static neutral idle with minimal pelvis displacement;
